posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
It's "tor-ti-ya" but not "va-ni-ya".

It's an interesting point to bring up actually, since both words originate from Spanish, yet only one keeps the Spanish pronuncitation.

posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
FWIW, the tortilla/vanilla thing was one chunk of an entire amusing digression about how wack English is as a language.

Also friendly pimping on WalkingTarget's behalf that he goes and checks spellings with Christopher before doing his summaries on Reddit/the wiki. So the wiki knew how to spell Hudbwyta! :3
